premisesReverified.dispatchPremiseWasWrong_reportedPerDevPr: The dispatch's own framing ('the two generators' actual source composition... locate by reading, not assuming') anticipated exactly this: 'X-ray' and 'Flood and Drainage' are NOT two separate report-generator code paths. Read-verified: 'xray'/'x-ray' does not appear anywhere in legacy-design-tools (zero hits, source/docs/tests/branches/commits). There is exactly ONE report generator in code -- buildR1Brief (artifacts/api-server/src/lib/r1BriefCompose.ts), composing five sections (zoning, setbacks-envelope, flood, land-use, drainage) from independent *FactRead.ts modules, served by ONE MCP tool (run_report -> POST /api/property-explorer/v1/research/brief, no report-type parameter). Cross-checked against doc_repo's own GTM glossary (_smartsite_masters/08_smart_site_glossary_and_quick_reference.md:17-19), which resolves the naming: 'Smart Site X-ray' IS the customer-facing name for this one deep-read report ('what you can build, flood and drainage, terrain, codes, utilities... Say X-ray, never brief'); 'Flood and Drainage' is named as 'the other live report' with no further code distinction given. Per DEV_PROCESS.md 3.2 ('the brief's numbers are the planner's, and the planner is often wrong -- say so'): this is not a blocker requiring operator escalation, because doc_repo's own canonical glossary resolves the naming question with direct evidence; it changes the SHAPE of the work (one generator to extend, not two) without changing the MISSION (both GTM products read from the same compose function and both benefit from the same fix).
premisesReverified.flood_and_drainage_are_not_symmetric: There is no 'drainage' rail anywhere in parcel_record's 65-rail set (verified against src/lib/parcel-record-engine/rail-keys.js in the hauska-factory work this same session already did -- companion group has flood, wells, specialDistricts, valueHistory, etc., no drainage). This card's dispatch step 4 only instructs a flood rendering change ('the record's reconciled zone + floodway flag... BFE renders only where a real value exists'), never mentions drainage. Scope: this card upgrades the FLOOD section of the R1 brief only. Drainage stays on its existing path (siteDrainage* modules / facets.drainage, often 'unread' per r1BriefCompose.ts's own DRAINAGE_UNREAD_REASON) -- untouched, not regressed, not silently improved by accident.
premisesReverified.parcelNodeId_equals_place_key_verified: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelNodeId.ts defines parcel_node_id = "{county_fips}:{normalizeCadPropId(prop_id)}" (leading zeros stripped from all-digit ids, non-numeric kept verbatim -- e.g. Williamson's R-prefix). parcel_record.place_key (hauska-factory, CHECK place_key = county_fips || ':' || prop_id) uses the SAME county_fips:prop_id shape with no normalization step of its own. Live-verified this session: zero parcel_record rows across all six counties have a leading-zero prop_id (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE prop_id ~ '^0') = 0 for every county), so there is currently no case where the two systems' prop_id values could diverge. Treated as a verified-for-current-data fact, not a structural guarantee: if a county's raw prop_id ever legitimately carries a leading zero, parcelNodeId's normalization and parcel_record's raw prop_id would disagree and a lookup would silently miss. Documented as a residual risk, not fixed (parcel_record's own prop_id sourcing is a hauska-factory concern, out of this card's repo).
premisesReverified.credentialCheck: No login-capable read-only Postgres role exists on the Factory Neon project (pg_read_all_data etc. exist but rolcanlogin=false; the only usable credential is neondb_owner, full write). Per dispatch item 2's own fallback ('use a read-only role if one exists, else SELECT-only usage'): SELECT-only usage is the path -- the new module will never construct anything but a SELECT statement, structurally incapable of writing regardless of the underlying credential's actual grants.

design.newModule: artifacts/api-server/src/lib/parcelRecordFactRead.ts, mirroring floodHazardFactRead.ts's established shape exactly: a lazy module-local pg.Pool resolved from FACTORY_DATABASE_URL (never ATOMS_DATABASE_URL), a refusal (not a silent null) when the env var is unset, a test seam (setParcelRecordQueryableForTests) matching the existing pattern, and parseParcelNodeId (already exported by parcelNodeId.ts) to derive {countyFips, propId} then place_key.
design.cellStateTranslation: Per dispatch step 3's explicit instruction (not the existing 3-state present/absent/refused vocabulary, which has no 'not-verified' concept): value -> a real value with provenance (source) and vintage; absent-verified -> the value's basis; not-applicable -> its reason; unaccounted -> rendered 'not-verified' (a new customer-facing phrase, never the raw word 'unaccounted'); refused -> a named refusal. This is a genuinely new rendering path in the flood section, not a reuse of FloodHazardFactRead's own state union -- reusing that union would silently collapse 'unaccounted' (nothing has looked yet) into 'absent' (a claim, not yet a confirmed absence), which is a real meaning loss the dispatch's own vocabulary avoids.
design.floodSectionChange: composeFloodBriefSection / summarizeFloodZoneExposure (r1BriefCompose.ts) gain a parcel-record-sourced path: read the flood cell (kind, and for kind=value the companion row payload {zone, floodway, bfe, dfirmId, method, sourceVintage} -- this exact shape independently verified live this session on real parcel_record rows) and prefer it over the existing atoms-based floodHazardFactRead result when the parcel_record cell is earned (value or absent-verified); fall back to the existing atoms path otherwise. BFE renders only when payload.bfe is a real number (never coerced from null), matching dispatch step 4 exactly and matching how floodHazardFactRead's own BFE rendering already behaves (nodeFacetBakeTier2.ts's own -9999 FEMA sentinel guard is the precedent for 'never surface a fake BFE').
design.wiring: propertyExplorer.ts's existing Promise.all fact-load block (lines ~150-166) gains one more parallel load; buildR1Brief's options gain a new field carrying the parcel-record flood fact, consumed only by composeFloodBriefSection. Zoning/setbacks-envelope/land-use sections and the drainage section are untouched -- zero regression surface on anything this card was not asked to change.
design.notInScope: Feasibility and Comparison report generators (not GTM-live per dispatch premise, confirmed not touched). Any change to floodHazardFactRead.ts, siteDrainage* modules, or nodeFacetBakeTier2.ts. Any write path -- SELECT-only, verified by code review before commit (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE anywhere in the new module).
